applicableAreas: Landscape near overhead electric distribution line along southern property boundary (Valley View Road)
findings.comment: Proposed trees are shown on the landscape plan near the overhead electric distribution line, but the plant schedule does not identify which species are utility-compatible per ECM Appendix F UC designation. Utility-compatibility status cannot be verified from the submitted plans.

The landscape plan does not show species identification for trees shown near utilities. Therefore, compliance with utility-compatibility requirements cannot be determined from the submitted plans.

applicableAreas: Landscape near overhead electric distribution line
findings.comment: Plant schedule does not provide mature height information for any proposed trees. Large trees (40+ feet per ECM Appendix F) cannot be identified or differentiated from the submitted plans.

applicableAreas: Landscape areas near overhead electric poles
findings.comment: Overhead electric utility poles are shown on the electrical plan (Sheet 21) but landscape plan (Sheet 31) does not show pole locations. Tree locations relative to poles cannot be verified.

Sheet 31 landscape plan shows proposed trees near OHE line but does not mark pole positions, making it impossible to measure the 10-foot lateral distance requirement from trees to pole centers.
agentTrace.reasoning: The landscape plan lacks utility pole location references needed to verify the 10-lateral-foot clearance requirement. The pole locations from Sheet 21 are not cross-referenced or overlaid on Sheet 31 where trees are shown.

applicableAreas: Landscape areas near pad-mounted electrical transformers

applicableAreas: Landscape areas within 20 feet of underground electrical equipment
findings.comment: Landscape plan does not show underground electrical equipment locations. Root barriers are not specified in any landscape notes or details. Compliance with root barrier requirements cannot be verified.

agentTrace.observation: Sheet 31 landscape plan notes (irrigation notes, general notes, key notes) contain no mention of root barriers. Sheet 35 plant schedule contains no root barrier specifications. Underground equipment locations are not shown on Sheet 31.
agentTrace.reasoning: Two separate deficiencies combine here: (1) cannot identify trees within 20 feet of underground equipment because equipment locations are not shown on landscape plan; (2) root barrier specifications (minimum 4 feet deep, positioned 5 feet from equipment) are not addressed anywhere on the plans.

findings.comment: Landscape plan legend defines tree symbols only as functional categories (M=Mitigation, PL=Parking Lot, SY=Street Yard, P=Parking Buffer Point Tree) but does not identify species. Species cannot be determined from the landscape plan where trees are shown.

applicableAreas: Landscape areas near overhead and underground electric facilities
findings.comment: Plans do not identify which proposed trees are within prohibited clearance zones (species and mature heights not specified). No Austin Energy written approval is referenced. Applicability and compliance cannot be determined.

agentTrace.observation: Sheets 31 and 35 contain no references to Austin Energy, no approval letters, and no species/height information to determine if trees fall within prohibited zones (15 feet for non-compatible from distribution, 25 feet for large trees from distribution, etc.).
agentTrace.reasoning: Trees cannot be assessed against prohibited zones without knowing their species (to determine utility-compatibility) and mature heights (to determine if 40+ feet). Additionally, any non-compliant trees would require documented Austin Energy written approval per UCM § 1.10.10.4 Exceptions, which is not referenced anywhere on the plans.
